items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: And I remember a time when I had rejoined the Casa Loma, that it, it was then called the Glen Gray Orchestra, down in Miami.

ctx.x: He had a big band for awhile.
Oh, yeah. And I remember a time when I had rejoined the Casa Loma, that it, it was then called the Glen Gray Orchestra, down in Miami.
I went down there with them and we were about to leave and the next guy following us in for his stint was Venuti, so Spike -- you know, he used to be with Goldkette band years ago.
